newsitem.title: USA: Winstar to sell $100 mln convertible pfd.
newsitem.headline: Winstar to sell $100 mln convertible pfd.

text.p: Winstar Communications Inc said Monday it had agreed to sell $100 million of convertible preferred stock at $25 a share, and warrants, to a group of institutional investors.
The private placement is fully subscribed and should be completed February 11, the company said.
The shares are convertible, starting in six months, at $25 each, subject to adjustment if the average market price of the common stock for the preceding 20 days is less than $25, the company said.
For each preferred share, the holder receives a warrant for 0.4 common share, exercisable at $25 per share, the company said.
Winstar said it has the right to call the warrants after three years, subject to certain terms, if the common share price exceeds $40 for 20 consecutive trading days.
